abilitygroupdescription.p: Ability Checks are any checks made using an ability. For example attack rolls are a type of ability check using an appropriate weapon ability, Sword Strike, as are spell casting checks using the appropriate magical spell ability. In this section we cover a few checks that are not made using an ability.
Special abilities are extraordinary abilities or racial abilities not available to most characters in the usual course of events.

check.effect: Add the Blindsight Rank to the check Skill dice when making attacks. Any penalties for attacking in the dark still apply.

abilitydescription.p: The character has heightened senses when fighting unseen opponents. They are atuned to slight noises and minor air movements that give away the location of unseen attackers. This ability is of no use at range.

abilitydescription.p:
Checks Encumbrance
Encumbrance Check
Encumbrance is an optional rule. The characters Encumbrance is a DC that players can be forced to check against when the characters are doing something where the weight of their pack could be a problem, characters climbing a mountain may have to make an Endurance check against their encumbrance or become exhausted. Encumbrance does not simply represent weight, it also represents the unwieldiness of the items being carried; how awkward it is to move while carrying the item.

playexample.p: Dourli tries to walk across a rope between two buildings. He rolls a success with a bane. The GM rules that Dourli falls, but catches the rope under his arms. The GM decides that Dourli must now make an Agility Check against his Encumberance DC or drop an item. Dourli rolls a 2 and 1, +0 for his Agility Rank, and fails miserably. There is no point calculating Dourli's Encumberance, he has clearly failed. The GM rules that this means that unfortunately, Dourli drops the gemstone he has just acquired into the canal below.

abilitydescription.p: In order to use encumbrance you should be using the standard character sheets. In the equipment section of the character sheet, marked against the side, are encumbrance values for each class of item (small, medium and large) and values for armour and coin. The total of these values is the characters encumbrance. Note that you do not count items twice ( a shield may be a large object in practice but its encumbrance is counted separately because of the encumbrance values for armour).

If you are going to use Encumberance then it is important that this rule does not become a long-winded exercise in accounting. First roll the check, then calculate the encumbrance (if required). Secondly, don't worry about getting the value exactly right - it will take to long. Just eye-ball it. Finally only bother calculating encumberance on demand, when the value is required.

Flat checks are catch-all check, when no ability really applies to the situation and no skill enters the equation. The player simply rolls a Check against a DC chosen by the GM, applying no Rank bonus. These checks are so context dependent it is up to the GM to determine all the parameters of the check including the DC, critical effects .
The character takes no damage from the given Damage Type

check.name: Talent
check.precondition: Anytime a character with this ability would Sprint (perform a double move action)
check.effect: The character moves at human sprint speed.

abilitydescription.p:
FIXME: definition of Sprint (or has that gone?)
Dwarves are natural sprinters. While slow to get moving, and not the most agile when it comes to dodging and quick changes of direction, Dwarves can build up a fair amount of speed in a straight line over time. Natural Sprinters get +Rank to any Speed checks made to run or for running jumps and the like.
The fey are resistant to damage from non-magically conductive sources. They have at their Fey Resistance rank.
Out of combat Fey creatures may make a magic check to magically heal health.

Any damage received is reduced by the ability rank for as a free response, a character with Resistance 2 is hit by a sword for 5 hit points damage. They take the 5 damage and then heal 2 for their Resistance leaving them with 3 damage.
The character takes an +Rank damage from the given Damage Type
